Title: Search any lawmaker's authored bills
Details: Look up a senator or representative and see every bill they've authored, across 13 congresses (1987 to present).

Title: Search bills by title, topic, or number
Details: Find bills by keyword or bill number, typed however you like: “SB 1294”, “hb4659”, or a topic.

Title: Bill pages with live status
Details: See where a 20th Congress bill is now, which committee it's in, a plain-language summary, and links to the official record.

Title: Watchlist
Details: Bookmark bills to follow. Statuses refresh every time you open it. No account needed.

Title: Sync your Watchlist across devices
Details: Optional Google sign-in keeps your Watchlist on every device.

Title: Install as an app
Details: Add CivicSync to your home screen from the browser, no app store needed. Pages you've visited still open offline.

Title: Works on phone, tablet, and desktop
Details: Layouts adapt to any screen: bottom tabs on phones, a sidebar and two-column pages on larger screens.

Title: Faster-feeling search
Details: A clear loading state while searching, and results that appear in stages so lawmakers and recent bills show first.

Title: About page
Details: What CivicSync is, where the data comes from, what it isn't, and who's behind it.

Title: Press kit
Details: Descriptions, fact sheet, logos, screenshots, and FAQ for journalists.

Title: Get involved page
Details: Ways to help: share, report data errors, suggest features, translate, contribute code, partner, or license commercially.

Title: Report an issue on every bill
Details: A “Report an issue” link on each bill page with the bill number and a template pre-filled.

Title: Official social accounts and share menu
Details: Follow CivicSync on Facebook and Instagram, and share it from the Get involved page.

Title: Open source, with commercial licences
Details: CivicSync's code is open source under the AGPL-3.0, with commercial licences for businesses that need other terms.

Title: Email that works without a mail app
Details: Email buttons open a panel with the address, Gmail compose, and copyable templates, so they work for webmail users too.

Title: Privacy-first notes
Details: Clear, low-key reminders that no account is needed and your Watchlist stays on your device unless you choose to sync.

Title: Lawmaker profiles with service record
Details: See which congresses a lawmaker served in, and in which chamber, on one profile.

Title: Filter a lawmaker's bills by congress
Details: Tabs for each congress a lawmaker served in, plus their full history.

Title: Live list of each lawmaker's current bills
Details: The 20th Congress tab updates from the live tracker, including bills filed since late 2025.

Title: Recently filed bills on the home page
Details: The newest Senate and House filings, right on the home page.

Title: Plain-language bill summaries
Details: Short, readable summaries of what a bill does, clearly labelled as automated, with the full text a tap away.

Title: Links to the official record
Details: Every bill links to its Senate or House record and the bill text, so you can verify at the source.

Title: Status at a glance
Details: Colour-coded status badges show whether a bill is in committee, moving, or law.

Title: Quick search suggestions
Details: One-tap example searches on the home page to help you get started.

Title: Clear notice when live data is unavailable
Details: If the live tracker is down, you'll see a clear message and everything else keeps working.

Title: Accurate authorship for shared surnames
Details: Lawmakers who share a surname (there are four Tulfos) are kept apart, so each profile shows only their own bills.

Title: Greetings in Filipino
Details: A “Magandang umaga / tanghali / hapon / gabi” greeting that follows the time of day in Manila.

Title: Share a bill from its page
Details: A share button on every bill page, using your phone's share sheet or copying the link.

Title: Friendly error and offline pages
Details: Helpful pages when something isn't found, a source is slow, or you're offline.

Title: Instant content updates
Details: Site text like the About page and FAQ updates within seconds, without downtime.

Title: Contributing guide and code of conduct
Details: Clear guidance for anyone who wants to help build CivicSync, with a commitment to staying non-partisan.

Title: Public roadmap
Details: This board: see what's shipped, what's next, and suggest or vote on ideas.

Title: Simpler navigation, with a More menu on phones
Details: A cleaner sidebar (main pages first, About and Get involved below) and a new More tab on phones, so every page is one tap away from anywhere.

Title: Author's role shown on every bill
Details: Every Senate and House bill shows who filed it and their role, Senator or Representative, in bill lists and on the bill page.

Title: Faster loading for users in the Philippines
Details: The app's servers now run in Singapore, closer to Philippine users.

Title: Lighter app on mobile data
Details: Sign-in features load only when you need them, halving the data used on a first visit.

Title: Rich previews when sharing
Details: Links to bills and lawmakers shared on Facebook, Messenger, and X show a preview card with the title and status.

Title: Our own web address
Details: Move from the temporary vercel.app link to a proper domain (e.g. civicsync.ph).

Title: Accessibility improvements
Details: Readable contrast in light and dark mode, a skip-to-content link, and an automatic accessibility check (WCAG 2.1 AA) on every change.

Title: More complete data for newer bills
Details: Work with data partners to fill gaps for bills filed since late 2025.

Title: Privacy-friendly analytics
Details: Anonymous, cookieless visit counts so we can see which pages are useful. No personal data, no cross-site tracking.

Title: Upgrade to the latest app framework (Next.js 16, React 19)
Details: Why: CivicSync runs on Next.js 14 and React 18, two major versions behind. Staying behind means newer tools increasingly won't work with it (the content editor already had to be hosted separately for this reason), older versions get less attention for bug and security fixes, and we miss performance improvements. What changes: page parameters become asynchronous (an official tool handles most of it), a small change to how cached content is refreshed, and a new default build tool. All current libraries support React 19. Plan: do it on a separate branch with a full check of every page before merging. Afterwards, the content editor can move into the app at /studio. Estimated effort: a few hours.

Title: Built-in forms for ideas and volunteers
Details: Join the translator list, propose a partnership, or ask about a commercial licence with a short form, without leaving CivicSync or needing an email app. Submissions are stored privately.

Title: Get notified when a bill you follow moves
Details: Receive a push notification or email digest when a Watchlist bill changes status.

Title: Filipino / Tagalog language option
Details: Switch the whole app to Filipino, translated and reviewed by people.

Title: Dark mode
Details: A darker colour scheme that's easier on the eyes at night. Follows your phone's setting automatically, or pick Light or Dark from the menu.

Title: Shareable bill and lawmaker cards
Details: Save a bill or lawmaker as an image for Instagram, Facebook or group chats. Preview the post (4:5) and story (9:16) side by side; bill cards show status, summary and progress, lawmaker cards show their record.

Title: “What does this status mean?” explainers
Details: Plain-language help for every bill status, a step-by-step "How a bill becomes law" guide with tap-or-hover definitions for terms like committee and floor, and a short intro for first-time visitors.

Title: Privacy page
Details: A full explanation of what's stored on your device, what's stored when you sign in, and what we never collect.

Title: Major regional languages
Details: Cebuano, Ilocano, Hiligaynon, Waray, Bikol, Kapampangan, and Pangasinan, reviewed by native speakers.

Title: Translated bill summaries
Details: Plain-language summaries in more languages, clearly labelled as machine-translated, with the original alongside.

Title: Browse bills by topic
Details: Explore 20th Congress bills by topic, like Health, Education or Agriculture, with the most relevant bills first and a Senate/House filter.

Title: Richer lawmaker profiles
Details: Photos, district or party-list, and Senate positions are live for current lawmakers. Still to come: committee memberships and frequent co-authors.

Title: Bill timelines
Details: See a bill's full history of status changes over time.

Title: Compare lawmakers side by side
Details: Pick up to three lawmakers and see them side by side: bills this Congress, bills that became law, bills per congress, main topics, and their laws.

Title: Link enacted bills to the final law
Details: Connect bills that became Republic Acts to the law's text.

Title: Faster, more reliable search
Details: Our own search index so results appear instantly and stay available when outside sources are down.

Title: Open dataset for other civic projects
Details: Publish cleaned, merged legislative data for others to build on.

Title: Exploring: voting records
Details: Researching whether we can show how lawmakers voted. This isn't available from our current sources yet.

Title: Community-contributed languages
Details: Volunteers can add and review new languages; each goes live only after a native-speaker review.

Title: Automated testing on every change
Details: Automatic checks on every change: unit tests for search, statuses and citations, plus a smoke test of key pages, so updates don't break the site.

Title: Uptime monitoring
Details: A monitor checks the site and its data sources every 5 minutes, so we catch outages before you do.

Title: Backup source for bill status
Details: So status still loads if our main tracker is down.

Title: Finalise contributor licensing
Details: Lawyer review of the Contributor License Agreement, a commercial licence template, and CLA Assistant on GitHub before accepting outside code.

Title: Find CivicSync on Google
Details: Every bill and lawmaker page is listed for search engines, with structured data, so searches like "SB 1294 status" lead straight to the bill.

Title: Embed a bill's live status on your site
Details: A copy-paste card or badge for blogs, newsrooms, school sites, GitHub, Notion and newsletters. Updates as the bill moves.

Title: Calendar and RSS feeds for your Watchlist
Details: RSS feeds are live: newly filed, bills on the move, each topic and each lawmaker. Calendar feeds for your Watchlist come next, once daily status tracking (CS-119) is in place.

Title: Ask about a bill on Messenger or Viber
Details: Send a bill number or lawmaker name to a chat bot and get the status and a link back. No app needed.

Title: Bill status inside news articles
Details: A browser extension that recognises bill numbers on any page (news, Facebook) and shows the live status on hover.

Title: Cite this bill
Details: One-tap citations (APA, Harvard, MLA, Chicago, BibTeX) on every bill, and a CSV download of any lawmaker's bills, for students, researchers and journalists.

Title: Clearer home page
Details: A home page with clear sections: search first, a live count of bills filed this Congress and this week, the latest bills, and a Start here guide you can close. Search suggestions are everyday topics, not politicians. A subtle animation on wide screens.

Title: Newly filed and On the move
Details: Switch the home feed between newly filed bills and bills that recently moved (passed a reading, scheduled for debate, or sent to the other chamber), and filter by Senate, House or both. On the move covers the House for now.

Title: Track status changes every day
Details: Save a daily snapshot of every bill's status so we know exactly when bills move. Adds Senate bills to On the move, and is the groundwork for Watchlist notifications, calendar feeds and the chat bot.

Title: Smarter search on Receipts
Details: Best matches ranked by meaning with plain-language summaries, Senate/House and Congress filters, your search words highlighted, and lawmaker results only when the name actually matches.

Title: Faster roadmap updates
Details: A one-line command updates this board from our code, and shipped items stop being tagged Deployed after 30 days automatically.

Title: Tidy author lists on busy bills
Details: Bills with dozens of authors show a count and the first five, with the rest in a compact list you can search (Find an author).

Title: Authors link to the right lawmaker
Details: Fixed: some authors opened the wrong profile when two sources spell a name differently (Brian Poe opened Grace Poe). Authors now link by official House member codes, and each lawmaker's live list includes bills filed under any of their names.

Title: Related bills
Details: Every bill page shows similar bills from the 20th Congress, including the same proposal filed in the other chamber.

Title: Print a bill page
Details: A clean, ink-friendly printout of any bill (status, summary, authors, sources) with a link back, for classes and handouts.

Title: Quicker ways to search
Details: Press / to search from anywhere, and a helpful not-found page with search and suggestions instead of a dead end.

Title: Lawmaker record at a glance
Details: Each lawmaker page shows bills on record, bills this Congress, and bills that became law this Congress, with bills per congress in their service record.

Title: Browse all lawmakers
Details: A sortable table of all 345 current senators and representatives: bills this Congress, became law, total on record, congresses served, or any past congress. Updated nightly.
